mentions.name: Agent Commerce
mentions.description: An experiment in having an AI agent run a full e-commerce website: a storefront connected to a print-on-demand supplier, where the agent releases new products and designs and ensures orders run without hiccups.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m seeing if an agent can run a full e-commerce website. Nothing fancy, just a storefront that connects to a print on demand supplier. The agent releases new products and designs and makes sure there’s no hiccups in the orders.
mentions.author: theturtletalks
